text:
## Ontology Principles  
1. **Realism:** Concepts map to real-world business entities
2. **Consistency:** Concepts maintain consistent definitions across documents
3. **Completeness:** Critical business concepts are defined
4. **Clarity:** Definitions are unambiguous and precise
5. **Traceability:** Concepts link to policies, procedures, and systems

raw_entities.name: Ontology
raw_entities.description: The foundational conceptual framework that defines how FirstUK Bank structures and understands its business entities, processes, and relationships. The ontology is built on five core principles: realism, consistency, completeness, clarity, and traceability.
context: Concepts map to real-world business entities
Concepts maintain consistent definitions across documents
Concepts link to policies, procedures, and systems

raw_entities.name: Realism Principle
raw_entities.description: A foundational ontology principle requiring that all concepts defined in the FirstUK Bank business ontology must map to real-world business entities, ensuring the conceptual model reflects actual banking operations and structures.
context: Realism: Concepts map to real-world business entities

raw_entities.name: Consistency Principle
raw_entities.description: A foundational ontology principle requiring that concepts maintain consistent definitions across all FirstUK Bank documents, preventing ambiguity and ensuring unified understanding of business entities throughout the organization.
context: Consistency: Concepts maintain consistent definitions across documents

raw_entities.name: Completeness Principle
raw_entities.description: A foundational ontology principle requiring that all critical business concepts relevant to FirstUK Bank operations are defined within the ontology, ensuring no essential banking entities or processes are omitted.
context: Completeness: Critical business concepts are defined

raw_entities.name: Clarity Principle
raw_entities.description: A foundational ontology principle requiring that all concept definitions within the FirstUK Bank ontology are unambiguous and precise, enabling consistent interpretation and application across the organization.
context: Clarity: Definitions are unambiguous and precise

raw_entities.name: Traceability Principle
raw_entities.description: A foundational ontology principle requiring that all concepts defined in the FirstUK Bank ontology link to supporting policies, procedures, and systems, establishing clear accountability and operational grounding for each conceptual entity.
context: Traceability: Concepts link to policies, procedures, and systems
